headline: Give dispatchers better options without letting the model move a crew
capabilities: Detect outages via real-time IoT sensors, prioritizing critical facilities
Dispatch nearest crews and reroute in-progress jobs automatically
Provide real-time dashboards and automated customer notifications
Optimize inventory staging and handle crew assignments
outcomes: Improved first-time fix rates and eliminated redundant travel
Delivered proactive customer updates, improving satisfaction
Protected revenue and demonstrated operational excellence during crisis events
why_try: A dispatch coordinator can ask who is eligible for a critical request and see the exact skill match and operational constraints before making a human decision.

sample_prompts.label: Field Operations Manager: Job dashboard
sample_prompts.prompt: What does tomorrow's job list look like by crew, and which crews are on standby?

sample_prompts.label: Service Director: Schedule optimization
sample_prompts.prompt: I need help optimizing our field technician schedules for tomorrow. We have 15 service calls.

sample_prompts.label: Dispatch Coordinator: Crew route and skill match
sample_prompts.prompt: Yes, show me Crew A-1's detailed route

sample_prompts.label: Emergency Duty Manager: Emergency response draft
sample_prompts.prompt: URGENT: Major power outage downtown - 1,200 customers affected. Dispatch emergency crews now!

sample_prompts.label: Control Room Operator: Live outage status
sample_prompts.prompt: Yes, give me live updates and customer impact

sample_prompts.label: Reliability Engineer: Post-incident review
sample_prompts.prompt: The outage is resolved. Show me the post-incident review and how we prevent the next one.

sample_prompts.label: Operations Analyst: Work orders and monthly report
sample_prompts.prompt: Yes, create the work orders and show me the monthly operations report

business_flow: Field operations managers, dispatch coordinators, service directors, and emergency duty managers
Microsoft Teams and approved customer communication
